realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12ch / WP-S2c-40 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as the first additional H-006 combined R1+R2 observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 30m history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-006 REP-0006 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0024 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0024 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0024 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0024 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0024 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0035 derives from OL-0024 and is the WP-S2c-40 H-006 d2_006_gates cycle 1 REC under approved combined R1+R2 methodology. It is the second REC observation for the exact segment H-006 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates, increasing the exact segment count from 1 to 2. It does not satisfy REC-5 and does not floor-cross the segment. Cost-drag is preserved but not deterministically compared because OL-0024.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0 makes cost_drag_fraction semantically uninterpretable as a pass/fail ratio. OL-0024 is reused by REC-0036 for the separate exp_success_criteria exact segment under R1 paired-source reuse; separate REC artifacts and separate expectation-source comparisons preserve exact-segment separation. REC-0035 does not create H-006 candidate approval, cohort-level approval, A2C-001 completion, Path B, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live/runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
notes: WP-12ch creates REC-0035 from new committed OL-0024 against committed D2-006 expectations.
